ja: 今日私がやらなきゃいけないのは、昨日見つかったログイン画面のバグを直すことです。
en: What I need to do today is fix the login bug we found yesterday.
alternatives: What I have to do today is fix the login bug we found yesterday.
The thing I need to do today is fix the login bug we found yesterday.
point: What I need to do is の後は動詞の原形でよい

ja: ログイン画面の修正はもうレビューされましたか？今日中にマージしたいんです。
en: Has the login page fix been reviewed yet? I'd like to get it merged today.
alternatives: Has anyone reviewed the login page fix yet? I want to get it merged today.
Has the fix for the login screen been reviewed yet? I'd like to merge it today.
point: 「もうされた？」は Has the fix been reviewed yet? の形

ja: 決済 API のテストで落ちているのは、先週追加したテストだけです。
en: The only tests failing in the payment API suite are the ones we added last week.
alternatives: The only failing tests in the payment API are the ones we added last week.
Only the tests we added last week are failing in the payment API suite.
point: failing や we added last week を名詞の後ろに置く

ja: 先週キャッシュの設定をちゃんと確認していたら、今こんなにこのバグで苦労していないはずです。
en: If I had checked the cache settings properly last week, I wouldn't be struggling with this bug now.
alternatives: If I'd properly checked the cache settings last week, I wouldn't be having so much trouble with this bug now.
If I'd checked the cache config carefully last week, I wouldn't be fighting this bug right now.
point: 過去の仮定は had checked、今の結果は wouldn't be -ing

ja: 昨日から決済 API のテストを書いているんですが、まだ半分くらいしか終わっていません。
en: I've been writing tests for the payment API since yesterday, but I've only finished about half.
alternatives: I've been working on the payment API tests since yesterday, but I've only gotten through about half of them.
Since yesterday I've been writing tests for the payment API, but only about half are done so far.
point: 「昨日から〜している」は現在完了進行形、「終わった」は現在完了

ja: インフラチームの誰か、データベース移行について少しアドバイスをもらえますか？そこで詰まっています。
en: Could someone on the infra team give me some advice on the database migration? I'm stuck on it.
alternatives: Can anyone on the infra team give me some advice about the database migration? I'm stuck on it.
Could someone from the infra team give me a few tips on the database migration? I'm stuck on that part.
point: advice は数えられないので an advice ではなく some advice
